UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated user profile and theme mode preferences (PAPER or DARK).

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

email.description: User email address from Google Sign-In (private to owner).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last update (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

ExamAttempt.title: ExamAttempt
ExamAttempt.description: Completed timed MCQ practice/mock exam attempt and score analysis.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

setId.description: Unique identifier of the PDF question set.

setHeading.description: Heading extracted from the PDF question set.

category.description: Category folder of the question set.

totalQuestions.description: Total number of MCQ questions in the set.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the attempt was submitted (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

SetProgress.title: SetProgress
SetProgress.description: Per-set MCQ practice progress for Sectional and PYQ sets.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

setHeading.description: Heading extracted from the PDF question set.

category.description: Category folder of the question set.

answeredCount.description: Number of questions answered so far.

totalQuestions.description: Total number of questions in the set.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when progress record was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last progress update (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/users/{userId}.description: Owner-only user profile and theme preferences.

/users/{userId}/exam_attempts/{attemptId.description: Owner-only history of completed timed MCQ exam attempts.

/users/{userId}/set_progress/{setId}.description: Owner-only instant-feedback MCQ progress for Sectional and PYQ sets.
